posts.title: I’ll tell you why it was never explored. Because the “reincarnation” thing is a plot device…
posts.description: rogue-rook : it still bothers me that wheel of time just doesn’t have any information about anyone ’s natural reincarnations other than the dragon reborn and the heroes of the horn, neither of which are happening organically. that everyone is reborn into a new life is a metaphysical semi-religious belief held by literally everyone in the randlands as empirically true without any empirical evidence
